Relief location map of the Northern Territory, Australia
Equidistant cylindrical projection, latitude of true scale 17.75° S (equivalent to equirectangular projection with N/S stretching 105 %). Geographic limits of the map:

N: 10.6° S
S: 26.5° S
W: 127.5° E
E: 139.5° E
